Comfort & accessibility

Card reading uses an available on-device voice. Private predictions and Garden Gate writing are never read aloud. Physical play includes a seated or spoken alternative.

Answers and shared creations stay only in this open page. Only Scripture-panel, reading-size, motion, and seasonal preferences are saved on this device. Reloading clears the evening. Keepsakes include only explicitly kept shared artifacts, never private answers.

A journey for two

Keyboard: Tab into the board, use arrow keys to inspect nearby spaces, Home/End to reach the first/last space, and Enter to open its description. This does not move your lanterns.

Share one device. Roll a six-sided die and move your two lanterns together. Complete the encounter on your space, then alternate who draws.

  • Moon-Mirror: privately predict your spouse’s answer; pass the device; reveal together. A match and a discovery both add light.
  • Memory Grove: tell a story, then draw a listening leaf for your spouse’s follow-up.
  • The Revel: laugh, move, or offer affectionate play. Timers are optional. Disagreement in a contest is a Glorious Tie.
  • Blessing Bower: offer a real gift of words, care, prayer, or service.

Fireflies can carry you forward. Brambles offer a small detour. Wild spaces let you choose. An orc raid invites three exercises of your choice, with seated alternatives and a quieter defense available.

Garden Gate is for mutually welcomed married romance. Write a personal invitation and choose whether to share it. Different write-ins can both be shared; checklist choices reveal only mutual welcomes. Private writing and selections are cleared at the reveal. Little Foxes addresses small shared habits—not serious harm or safety concerns.

Passing has no penalty. You can always replace a card or choose something lighter. Reach the pavilion, gather twelve lights, or end at any moment: you win together.

The woodland is imagined. Scripture speaks with God’s authority; Jesus Christ is our Creator and Lord. The reflections apply passages to shared life, while game rules and optional activities are human inventions. Read each passage in context. “Alassë” is Quenya for joy or happiness. Language note.

Make something together

Choose Together tonight for a quest, a collaborative Greenwood Tale, a tiny ritual, or a short prayer. Quests stay open across turns; three more encounters is a suggestion, never a deadline. Lantern charms simply mark shared moments. They do not rank your marriage.

Moonlight draws favor deeper cards while keeping lighter surprises and avoiding repeats until the available pool is used. “Something lighter” changes this turn; “Keep it playful” can stay in Meadow for the rest of the evening.

Hearth & Star is included automatically from November 1 through the end of January 1, with Thanksgiving, Advent, Christmas, and New Year cards appropriate to the date. Choose Automatic, Include, or Quiet in Tonight’s pace. January 2 returns Automatic to the ordinary decks.

At the pavilion, keep one small promise each if you wish. Preview, copy, or print the shared keepsake; download a calendar reminder only for promises you chose to keep. A calendar file must be opened and accepted in your calendar app. The keepsake excludes Moon-Mirror answers, Garden Gate writing, and repair disclosures. Shared fiction and written plans are included only after you choose to keep them.

Care for one another

Bridge of Mercy is an original, optional conversation for small hurts, not a clinically validated REACH exercise. Both spouses must opt in each time, and either can leave at once. Little Foxes addresses small shared habits. Neither is for abuse, fear, coercion, affairs, serious betrayal, an addiction crisis, or feeling unsafe.

If you feel afraid of your partner, are being threatened or hurt, or do not feel free to say no, this game is not the place to work through it. Seek appropriate professional support; wise pastoral care can also help. In the U.S., the National Domestic Violence Hotline is available at 1-800-799-7233 or by texting START to 88788. For immediate danger, contact local emergency services.

Together edition · October 17, 2026. Original game questions and activities; Scripture, reflection, and game mechanics remain distinct. No live AI or analytics were added. On-device speech is optional and never includes private answers.
